comparison.objective: Pull a call-for-aid cord grip downward 15 cm; candidate fractures four HELICOIL tangs and retrieves them.
comparison.physical_skill: Cord grasping and measured downward pulling versus coaxial rigid-tool alignment, controlled hammer impact, and small-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Grip displaced 15 cm on its pivot bracket; other rubric details are absent. Candidate requires four retained-insert-safe fractures and four tangs in a tray.
comparison.reason: The explicit measured cord-pull ability does not test impact fracture, tool-on-tool striking, or debris containment.
